We had many people in our comments who assumed we were just random people who bought a tiger cub and many people asking where they can get a tiger. We want to address this because it’s very important. Rick is not just a normal person with a tiger. Rick owns a USDA licensed zoo and Mowgli is not a personal pet. Mowgli came from another zoo and was not purchased as a pet. The reason Mowgli is inside the house (which is on the zoo property) is because he is not fully vaccinated and we will not allow him outside until our vet clears us for that. Anyone who is wanting a pet tiger needs to know that you cannot legally own one as a pet. Also, this is not Rick’s first Tiger. You can go and see Kai, our female, on our page. Rick has extensive experience with big cats and raising them. You can however enjoy how cute he is on our social media! We will NEVER have tiger encounters available and no visitors will ever be allowed to touch him or interact with him. When he is older and cleared to go outside you can see him in his enclosure if you visit the zoo. We hope that clears a few things up!

Feb 2, 2026 At Shenyang Forest Wild Animal Zoo in Liaoning, China, visitors on a safari tour got a show they’ll never forget. One curious Siberian tiger approached a tiger themed safari bus and sank its powerful jaws into a tire, chewing and tugging as if it were a toy. Passengers inside, safely behind reinforced glass, watched in stunned amusement as the bus briefly came to a halt under the tiger’s grip. Just as it seemed the tire might lose the battle, a second tiger stepped in, like a no-nonsense older sibling. Grabbing the first tiger by the rear, it tugged insistently until the tire biter let go. The two tigers then faced off for a short, non aggressive standoff, as if settling a playground squabble. The scene perfectly captured the mix of curiosity, playfulness, and social rules these apex predators maintain, even in captivity. In the end, the tire survived, the tigers settled their differences, and everyone learned that even the fiercest predators sometimes need a buddy to keep them in check. This short, chaotic, and hilarious moment proves that even the fiercest creatures have rules… and sometimes a tiger buddy knows when to step in. #wildlife #viral #CaughtOnCamera #funnyvideos #FYP
